chooser.title: Sign in to TinyBrains
chooser.subtitle: Choose how you'd like to continue.
chooser.failedTitle: We couldn't load the sign-in options.
chooser.failedBody: Something went wrong reaching the server. Try again in a moment.
chooser.emptyTitle: Sign-in is not set up yet.
chooser.emptyBody: No sign-in providers are configured for this deployment. If you run it, add one to the sign-in settings.

pending.title: Finishing your sign-in…
pending.body: Your provider sent you back. We're checking that you started this sign-in, then we'll return you to the page you left.

failed.title: We could not confirm that you started this sign-in.
failed.body: We set a short-lived cookie before sending you to your provider and check for it when you come back. Your browser did not send it back, and a link alone is not enough to sign you in.

notice.title: Your account is fine.
notice.body: Start again from the same address. Your versions and your rating are as you left them.

failed.reasonsHeading: If it keeps happening, look for one of these.
reasons: You started on one address and came back on another. Your browser returns the cookie only to the exact address that set it, even when both addresses reach this site.
Your browser is blocking cookies for this site, or you are in a window that discards them.
You left the provider's page open too long, and the cookie expired.
You opened the callback link by hand, or opened it twice. Each link works once.
You declined the provider's consent screen. We get the same answer for that as for a missing cookie, so this page cannot tell them apart.

identity.title: We could not tell who you are.
identity.body: You signed in with your provider, but when we asked it who you are it did not answer, or answered with an error. Nothing was written, and you are not signed in.

notice.title: Your account is fine.
notice.body: This is on the provider's side or between us and it, usually for a minute or two. Try again shortly; your versions and your rating are as you left them.
